summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing the poll results of its Annual General Meeting held 5 November 2026, the US-equivalent disclosure for a UK AGM outcome. All 25 resolutions passed, including the 2026 report and accounts (99.18% for), directors' remuneration report (97.92%), declaration of the final dividend (99.91%), and election of Sir Dave Lewis and Alex Keith as directors. Special resolutions authorizing share allotment, pre-emption disapplication, and buyback authority (99.83%) also passed. No transaction terms, advisors, or deal mechanics; a routine meeting notice with no special-situation angle.
